0022600189.text: Denver (4-3, 4th in the Northwest, 9th in the West) meets Indiana (3-6, 10th in the East) in the NBA Mexico City Game, a neutral-site contest in which the Nuggets are the designated road team and playing their eighth game of the season. Denver is without Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain, and DeMar DeRozan is day-to-day with back spasms and is a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Kelly Oubre Jr. day-to-day with a calf bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 135-120 victory in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
